in_sanskrit.name: Manigandan
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God of Wealth
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Manigandan एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Mani means jewel and Ganda means wealth. Manigandan is a name of Lord Murugan who is believed to bestow wealth, prosperity and success.

in_hindi.name: Manigandan
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God of Wealth
in_hindi.long_meaning: Manigandan एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Mani means jewel and Ganda means wealth. Manigandan is a name of Lord Murugan who is believed to bestow wealth, prosperity and success.

in_tamil.name: மாணிக்கந்தான்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Manigandan is derived from the Tamil words 'mani' meaning jewel or wealth and 'gandan' meaning personified. Thus, the name Manigandan can be translated as 'God of wealth' or 'Wealth personified'. This name is often given to boys born into wealthy families or those who are believed to bring prosperity and wealth to their families.

in_telugu.name: Manigandan
in_telugu.meaning: హిందూ పేరు అంటే God of Wealth
in_telugu.long_meaning: Manigandan ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। Mani means jewel and Ganda means wealth. Manigandan is a name of Lord Murugan who is believed to bestow wealth, prosperity and success.

in_marathi.name: Manigandan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Wealth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Manigandan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mani means jewel and Ganda means wealth. Manigandan is a name of Lord Murugan who is believed to bestow wealth, prosperity and success.

in_bengali.name: Manigandan
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God of Wealth
in_bengali.long_meaning: Manigandan একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Mani means jewel and Ganda means wealth. Manigandan is a name of Lord Murugan who is believed to bestow wealth, prosperity and success.
